conclusions: Self-attribution is large: Qwen 75% and Phi 87% claim credit when the system healed itself, while both are 94-100% correct when the agent truly caused recovery.
Mistral avoids the error by abstaining (73% NEJASNO) but then misses 70% of genuine causal cases: abstention is not calibration.
Attribution error is a false-success channel that neither the action gate (call allowed) nor the evidence gate (artifact exists) covers; reports need a before/after causality trace.
Text vignettes measure disposition, not production behaviour; single seed.
